source.method: Compiled Tailwind v4 stylesheet (no source maps served) plus a Playwright capture: computed styles, 21 scroll frames and a scroll-through video at 1440px.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and panel ground; the inner layer of every card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The landing's cool off-white (`--landing-surface`) behind the hero and agent sections. The marketing site is light only; the dark value is the app's `card`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised cards, popovers and the FAQ items.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: The grey outer layer of a dashboard card (`muted` at 70%): it holds the label row and frames a `background` card inside.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, hover fills, sidebar active row.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill ("Explore demo").

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`. 16.1:1 light, 14.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Headlines, numbers and body text. 19.8:1 on `background` light, 16.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: foreground-soft
tokens.usage: The grey second line of two-tone headlines ("for you and your agent"). 4.4:1 light: display sizes only (24px+), never body text.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Body copy, nav, labels, table heads. 4.7:1 on `background`, 4.5:1 on `surface`, 4.46:1 on `well`, just under AA: the site's own pairing for 12px card labels, so keep labels short and medium weight. Dark: 6.6:1 on `background`, 6.1:1 on `well`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, inputs, the nav bar outline (used at 40–70% strength).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring around inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Tracwell blue: primary buttons, the final CTA band, active dots. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `primary`. 3.8:1 — the site's own pairing on 14px semibold buttons; it misses AA, so keep labels short and never put body copy on `primary`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Negative deltas and errors. 4.9:1 on `background` light, 6.2:1 on `card` dark.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text in positive-delta pills ("+18.4%"). 5.2:1 on `success-soft` light, 5.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Positive-delta pill ground. Dark value from the site's own emerald scale.

tokens.name: data-traffic
tokens.usage: Traffic series: bars, lines, the "Indexing" bot dot.

tokens.name: data-traffic-text
tokens.usage: Text in traffic tags and status badges. 6.7:1 on `data-traffic-soft` light, 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: data-traffic-soft
tokens.usage: Bar-list fills and traffic tag grounds.

tokens.name: data-revenue
tokens.usage: Revenue series.

tokens.name: data-revenue-text
tokens.usage: Text in revenue tags ("$290 purchase"). 7.0:1 on `data-revenue-soft` light, 7.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: data-revenue-soft
tokens.usage: Revenue tag grounds and area fills.

tokens.name: data-acquisition
tokens.usage: Acquisition series; the "AI fetch" bot dot.

tokens.name: data-acquisition-text
tokens.usage: Text in acquisition tags. 7.1:1 on `data-acquisition-soft` light, 7.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: data-acquisition-soft
tokens.usage: Acquisition tag grounds.

tokens.name: data-engagement
tokens.usage: Engagement series: funnels, the "Training" bot dot.

tokens.name: data-engagement-text
tokens.usage: Text in engagement tags. 7.8:1 on `data-engagement-soft` light, 8.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: data-engagement-soft
tokens.usage: Engagement tag grounds and funnel bands.

tokens.name: data-positive
tokens.usage: Up-arrow deltas in charts ("↗ 12.4%"). 2.1:1 on white — the site's own value; use it for marks and icons, and `success-text` for any figure someone must read.

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: "Install" step card ground. `foreground` 17.3:1. Dark values reuse the app's dark data fills; the landing itself is light only.

tokens.name: tint-lilac
tokens.usage: AI-traffic section band.

tokens.name: tint-mint
tokens.usage: "Ask" step card and revenue band ground. `foreground` 17.6:1.

tokens.name: tint-peach
tokens.usage: "Track" step card ground.

tokens.name: tint-rose
tokens.usage: Spare landing tint; one per section at most.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: The agent terminal panel. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: terminal-raised
tokens.usage: The prompt line inside the terminal.

tokens.name: terminal-text
tokens.usage: Prompt and answer text. 16.3:1 on `terminal`.

tokens.name: terminal-dim
tokens.usage: Tool-call lines ("● tracwell - analytics_revenue (MCP)"). 12.0:1 on `terminal`.

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Hints ("? for shortcuts"). 6.9:1 on `terminal` (the site uses #737373 at 3.7:1; lifted here).

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero headline, two lines: first in `foreground`, second in `foreground-soft`. -0.03em.
styles.sample: Product analytics for you and your agent

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Hero and section intros in `muted-foreground`, max 36rem.
styles.sample: Tracwell follows every visit through signup and payment.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav links, sidebar items, row names.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and table heads. +0.08em.

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: Agent terminal and code snippets; the site uses the system monospace.
styles.sample: ❯ What brought paying customers last week?

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline URLs such as the MCP endpoint.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Well padding around the inner card; Tailwind's base step (0.25rem).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon gaps; bar-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Bar-row and badge inline padding; gaps between dashboard cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inline padding; nav-button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Secondary hero button padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between feature cards; FAQ row padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; feature card padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Padding inside a tinted landing band.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: CTA band vertical padding; section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text links (focus outline).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Sidebar items and bar-list rows (`--radius`, 0.625rem).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The inner card of a well, inputs, floating chips.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, wells, the dashboard frame and the terminal.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The FAQ well.

tokens.name: radius-band
tokens.usage: Landing bands, the CTA band and the floating nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: FAQ items and the AI-traffic panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, badge and segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-hairline
tokens.usage: A 1px ring instead of a border: the active sidebar item.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Dashboard wells.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Event chips that float over a visual.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The big product frame in the hero and revenue band; once per section.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Step-card mockups and the terminal.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: The top highlight on `primary` buttons.
